scope: Square brush (slot 4) Size 3 end transfer (0086): isolated 40-column L->R strokes at two column ranges; pic3 controls described; research only

brush.note: context ShapeSlot stays the frozen round geometry context; the pilot selects slot 4 itself

compensation.endLR: L->R from centre(a+2) to centre(b+1)+offset px; offset -1 equals pic3 geometry
compensation.basis: 0086: round Size 3 right end always half a texel (k+0.55/k-0.45); hypothesis: square stamp ends on whole texels

rules.controls: descriptive for square: same calib1 label rule as pic3 (round footprint model); a mismatch characterises the square footprint, it does not reject the derived family
rules.edges: per stroke, side and stamp-row sample: edge by (bg+inside)/2 stepping outward from the frozen sample (3 columns inside) on the sweep stage before/after; residual = column phase(edge) - boundary; a side is measured when >=80% of its samples are
rules.endLR: per sweep: END_EXACT_AT(d) when some end offset d has every measured right-edge sample within |residual|<=0.15 in both repetitions (smallest mean |residual| wins); otherwise END_NO_EXACT_STATE; unmeasured offsets -> UNMEASURED
rules.hEdges: descriptive: top/bottom paint edge at 5 mid columns, reported as observation row coordinate minus stroke row

hypotheses.endLR: END_EXACT_AT(d) for some d in both sweeps
hypotheses.endLR2: END_EXACT_AT(d) for some d in both sweeps
